video:video.video:title: Sleep Token Explained - EP One: Elation, Entry, and Erasure
video:video.video:description:
A deep dive into Sleep Token’s EP One — not from the beginning, but from the middle.
This video explores the emotional and symbolic arc of three songs: Thread the Needle, Fields of Elation, and When the Bough Breaks.
Through imagery, lyrics, and visual language, we try to understand:
What “Sleep” represents Why the mask exists And how something that begins as elation can slowly turn into erasure
This is not a definitive explanation. Just an attempt to make sense of the patterns — the attachment, the devotion, and the collapse.
